mcpServers.name: Escalation MCP
mcpServers.description: MCP server that escalates support tickets directly to a human on-call team for immediate attention, returning the assigned team and a tracking ID for follow-up.

lastPublish.name: Escalation MCP
lastPublish.description: Escalates an IT ticket to a human

tools.name: escalateTicket
tools.description: Escalates a support ticket to the on-call team for immediate attention. Accepts a ticket_id, a severity level (high or low), a reason summarizing why escalation is needed, and a full description of the issue. Notifies the on-call team and returns an escalation confirmation including the assigned team and a tracking ID for follow-up.

ticket_id.description: The Jira ticket ID to escalate

description.description: Full description of the support ticket

mock_scenarios.name: Successful escalation
mock_scenarios.response: {"success":true,"ticket_id":"PROJ-123","assigned_team":"on-call","tracking_id":"ESC-4821","message":"Ticket PROJ-123 escalated to the on-call team."}

mcpServers.name: Jira MCP
mcpServers.description: Mock MCP server exposing a Jira ticket-update tool for testing agent workflows that transition issue status and add resolution comments.

tools.name: updateIssue
tools.description: Updates a Jira ticket with a new status and adds a comment with resolution details. Accepts a ticket_id identifying the Jira issue, a status value (open, in-progress, resolved, escalated, or closed), and a comment describing the resolution or reasoning behind the change. Applies the status transition on the ticket and appends the comment to its activity log, then returns a confirmation of the update including the ticket ID, the new status, and a timestamp.

comment.description: Comment to add to the ticket with resolution details

ticket_id.description: The Jira ticket ID to update

mock_scenarios.name: Successful ticket update
mock_scenarios.response: {"success":true,"ticket_id":"PROJ-123","status":"resolved","message":"Ticket PROJ-123 updated to resolved and comment added."}

agentCards.name: Help Center Agent
agentCards.description: Searches the IT knowledge base for answers to common issues. Returns relevant articles with step-by-step instructions.

skills.name: Knowledge Base Search
skills.description: Search for IT help articles and known solutions. Queries the internal knowledge base using keywords or a description of the issue, matches against existing articles covering common problems like VPN access, email sync, and account resets, and returns the most relevant article along with step-by-step remediation instructions.
examples: How do I reset my VPN password when I am locked out of the corporate network?
My Outlook email stopped syncing after the latest update, what troubleshooting steps should I take?
I am trying to log into Figma but I am getting a license error, is there a knowledge base article for this?

agentCards.name: License Procurement Agent
agentCards.description: Checks software license availability and provisions licenses for employees.

skills.name: License Check and Provision
skills.description: Check license availability and provision for a user. Looks up current seat counts for the requested software title, verifies whether a license is available or must be purchased, and if available assigns and activates the license for the requesting employee, returning confirmation of the assignment.
examples: Does the marketing team have an available Tableau license for a new hire starting next Monday?
Please provision a Figma seat for employee jdoe@company.com under the design team license pool.
Check if there is a spare Adobe Creative Cloud license before purchasing a new one for the finance team.
